record.context_brief: Support size from delayed negative coefficients
record.original_question: Let κ:[−1,1]→R have a Gegenbauer expansion with some negative coefficients c_ℓ, all occurring only in degrees ℓ>N for a large N. If the associated energy I_κ has a discrete minimizer μ*, what can be said about the size of the support of μ*?

evidence.quote: Problem 4.1 (Dmitriy Bilyk). Let κ: [−1, 1] → R. Assume that there exist negative coefficients cl in the Gegenbauer expansion of κ(t), where l > N for some large N. If there exists a discrete minimizer µ∗ of Iκ, what can one say about the size of the support of µ∗?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $S^{d-1}\subset\mathbb{R}^d$ be the unit sphere ($d\ge 2$), and for a fixed parameter $\lambda=(d-2)/2$ let $\{C_\ell^{\lambda}\}_{\ell\ge 0}$ denote the Gegenbauer (ultraspherical) polynomials, normalized so that the sequence $\{C_\ell^{\lambda}(t)\}_{\ell\ge 0}$ forms an orthogonal basis of $L^2([-1,1], (1-t^2)^{\lambda-1/2}\,dt)$. Recall the classical theorem of Schoenberg: a continuous function $\kappa:[-1,1]\to\mathbb{R}$ is positive definite on $S^{d-1}$ if and only if its Gegenbauer expansion
$$\kappa(t)=\sum_{\ell=0}^{\infty} c_\ell\, C_\ell^{\lambda}(t)$$
has all coefficients $c_\ell\ge 0$.

For a Borel probability measure $\mu$ on $S^{d-1}$, define the energy
$$I_\kappa(\mu)=\iint_{S^{d-1}\times S^{d-1}} \kappa(\langle x,y\rangle)\,d\mu(x)\,d\mu(y).$$
Call $\mu^{*}$ a discrete minimizer of $I_\kappa$ if $\mu^{*}$ minimizes $I_\kappa$ over all Borel probability measures on $S^{d-1}$ and $\mathrm{supp}(\mu^{*})$ is a finite set.

Suppose $\kappa$ has a Gegenbauer expansion in which every negative coefficient $c_\ell<0$ occurs only at indices $\ell>N$ for some large integer $N$, while $c_\ell\ge 0$ for all $\ell\le N$. Assuming $I_\kappa$ admits a discrete minimizer $\mu^{*}$, derive quantitative information about $|\mathrm{supp}(\mu^{*})|$ in terms of $N$ (and the dimension $d$). In particular, can one give a lower bound on $|\mathrm{supp}(\mu^{*})|$ that grows with $N$?
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is posed by Bilyk in a recent open-problems collection (UP24). Related work by Bilyk and collaborators establishes existence of discrete minimizers and the empty-interior property of supports when the potential is not positive definite, but no quantitative bound on the support size from "delayed" negative Gegenbauer coefficients appears in the literature. No solution was located in the search.

status_evidence.title: Energy on spheres and discreteness of minimizing measures
status_evidence.snippet: Establishes discreteness of minimizers for energies with non–positive-definite polynomial potentials, but does not give support-size bounds from the index of the first negative Gegenbauer coefficient.
status_evidence.claim: Closely related framework but does not resolve the quantitative question.

status_evidence.title: Bounds on energy and potentials of discrete measures on the sphere
status_evidence.snippet: Recent (2024) work on discrete energy bounds on spheres; does not address the specific question of estimating support size from the threshold N beyond which negative Gegenbauer coefficients can occur.
status_evidence.claim: Recent related work does not contain a resolution of the problem.
